statement: Find the remainder when $p(x)=x^4-5x^3+6x^2-4x+3$ is divided by $x^2-1$.
solution: Let the remainder be $ax+b$. Since $x^2-1=0$ at $x=\pm1$, $p(1)=1-5+6-4+3=1$ and $p(-1)=1+5+6+4+3=19$. So $a+b=1$, $-a+b=19$, giving $b=10$, $a=-9$. The remainder is $-9x+10$.
hints: The remainder on division by a quadratic is linear $ax+b$.
